_note: Rule set for the upgrade path DBR 15.4 LTS -> 17.3 LTS. 'verified' rules were checked against the official release notes on 2026-10-29 (see 'source' and 'evidence'). Rules marked verified=false are general deprecation advisories that were NOT checked against the Databricks release notes. 'introduced_in' is the first Databricks Runtime version where the change applies.

rules.title: Modules removed in Python 3.12 (distutils, imp)
rules.description: Databricks Runtime 16.0 and above ship Python 3.12, which no longer includes the distutils and imp modules. Code that imports them fails with ImportError.
rules.recommendation: Replace distutils.version.LooseVersion with packaging.version.Version, and imp with importlib.
rules.evidence: DBR 16.0 system environment lists Python 3.12.3 (15.4 LTS uses Python 3.11). The removal of distutils and imp is part of Python 3.12 itself.

rules.title: ANSI SQL mode is on by default (Databricks Runtime 17.0, Spark 4.0)
rules.description: From Databricks Runtime 17.0 the default SQL dialect is ANSI. Invalid casts, malformed date strings and integer overflow raise runtime errors instead of returning null.
rules.recommendation: Validate input before casting, or use try_cast through F.expr for dirty data. To keep the old behaviour deliberately, set spark.sql.ansi.enabled to false explicitly. Update tests that expect null for bad input.
rules.evidence: DBR 17.0 release notes list 'ANSI SQL enabled by default'; the ANSI compliance page states spark.sql.ansi.enabled defaults to true in DBR 17.0 and above and that invalid inputs throw runtime exceptions.

rules.title: DataFrame.registerTempTable is deprecated
rules.description: registerTempTable has been deprecated since Spark 2.0 in favour of createOrReplaceTempView.
rules.evidence: General deprecation advisory; not checked against the Databricks release notes.

rules.title: SQLContext is deprecated
rules.description: SQLContext and HiveContext have been superseded by SparkSession since Spark 2.0.
rules.evidence: General deprecation advisory; not checked against the Databricks release notes.

rules.title: PandasUDFType is deprecated
rules.description: Pandas UDF types (PandasUDFType.SCALAR and similar) were deprecated in Spark 3.0 in favour of Python type hints.
rules.recommendation: Declare the UDF with Python type hints, for example def f(s: pd.Series) -> pd.Series.
rules.evidence: General deprecation advisory; not checked against the Databricks release notes.

rules.title: RDD API usage
rules.description: The RDD API is not available on every compute type (for example standard access mode clusters and serverless compute).
rules.recommendation: Rewrite with DataFrame operations, or run on a compute type that supports RDDs.
rules.evidence: General advisory; not checked against the Databricks release notes.

rules.title: DBFS mounts
rules.description: Mount points (dbutils.fs.mount, /mnt paths, /dbfs/mnt) are a legacy access pattern; Databricks recommends Unity Catalog volumes or external locations.
rules.recommendation: Read from Unity Catalog volumes (/Volumes/<catalog>/<schema>/<volume>) or external locations.
rules.evidence: General advisory; not checked against the Databricks release notes.

rules.title: Legacy Spark SQL configuration flags
rules.description: spark.sql.legacy.* flags restore old behaviour and may be removed in later Spark versions.
rules.recommendation: Remove the flag and fix the code for the new behaviour, or document why it is still needed.
rules.evidence: General advisory; not checked against the Databricks release notes.

rules.title: input_file_name function is no longer supported (Databricks Runtime 17.3 LTS)
rules.description: input_file_name has been deprecated since Databricks Runtime 13.3 LTS because it is unreliable, and it is no longer supported in 17.3 LTS and above.
rules.recommendation: Read the file path from the _metadata column (for example _metadata.file_path) instead. Confirm the exact replacement in the Databricks documentation for your data source.
rules.evidence: DBR 17.3 LTS release notes, behavioral changes: the function is no longer supported.

rules.title: Auto Loader incremental listing default changed (Databricks Runtime 17.3 LTS)
rules.description: The default of the deprecated cloudFiles.useIncrementalListing option changed from auto to false, so Auto Loader now performs full directory listings.
rules.recommendation: Review Auto Loader streams that relied on incremental listing. To keep the previous behaviour set cloudFiles.useIncrementalListing to auto explicitly, or migrate to file events.
rules.evidence: DBR 17.3 LTS release notes, behavioral changes.

rules.title: pandas API on Spark methods removed in Spark 4.0 (Databricks Runtime 17.0)
rules.description: Spark 4.0 removed several pandas API on Spark members, including DataFrame.iteritems, Series.iteritems, DataFrame.to_koalas, DataFrame.to_pandas_on_spark and the .koalas accessor.
rules.recommendation: Use items instead of iteritems, and pandas_api instead of to_koalas and to_pandas_on_spark. Note that .iteritems also matches plain pandas code, so check what the object is.
rules.evidence: PySpark migration guide, upgrading from 3.5 to 4.0. DBR 17.0 ships Spark 4.0.0.

rules.title: pandas API on Spark and ANSI mode (Databricks Runtime 17.0 and 17.2)
rules.description: pandas API on Spark behaves differently when ANSI mode is on. In Spark 4.0 it raises an exception unless a compatibility option is set, and Databricks Runtime 17.2 enables ANSI support for it by default.
rules.recommendation: Test pandas API on Spark code with ANSI mode on. Review the compute.ansi_mode_support and compute.fail_on_ansi_mode options.
rules.evidence: PySpark 3.5 to 4.0 migration guide and DBR 17.2 release notes ('ANSI mode enabled by default for Pandas API on Spark').

rules.title: Scala 2.13 replaces Scala 2.12 (Databricks Runtime 17.0)
rules.description: Databricks Runtime 17.0 and above use Scala 2.13, while 15.4 LTS uses Scala 2.12. Libraries built for Scala 2.12 (artifact names ending in _2.12) cannot be loaded.
rules.recommendation: Use the _2.13 build of each Maven coordinate and test the job on the new runtime.
rules.evidence: DBR 17.0 system environment lists Scala 2.13.16; DBR 15.4 LTS and 16.x list Scala 2.12.15.
